title: Prohibition.
partHeading: PART III. ASBESTOS EMISSION AND LEAD HAZARD CONTROL
bodyText:
PART III. ASBESTOS EMISSION AND LEAD HAZARD CONTROL

No person, including any public body, shall engage in any activity that causes a violation of this chapter.
